def LiteralProps (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 (R : BottomData) (C : Tree) (qa ub : RMAF.Vertex) : Prop :=
 properPair T S=true ∧
 subtree S R.w=some (bottom R.sa R.sc R.sb R.a R.b d.c R.X) ∧
 (∃ i∈HardParent.vertices T, CherryAt T i R.a R.b ∨ CherryAt T i R.b R.a) ∧
 (cuts S R.a R.b).length=2 ∧
 (∀ z∈leaves T, z∈leaves C ↔ z∉leaves R.X ∧ z≠d.c) ∧

def buildOne (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 (R : BottomData) : Option (LiteralGeometry T S) :=
 match hc : subtree T v, leafAddress? T R.a, leafAddress? T R.b with
 | some C,some qa,some ub =>
   if h : LiteralProps T S a b d u v R C qa ub then some (ofProps hc h) else none
 | _,_,_ => none

structure LiteralCall where
 row : BottomData
 core : Tree
 qa : RMAF.Vertex
 ub : RMAF.Vertex
 selection : BadSelection
 u : RMAF.Vertex

def LiteralCallDomain (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex) (j : LiteralCall) : Prop :=
 j.row∈rows S a b d.c ∧ subtree T v=some j.core ∧
 leafAddress? T j.row.a=some j.qa ∧ leafAddress? T j.row.b=some j.ub ∧ j.selection=d ∧ j.u=u ∧ j.v=v

theorem one_calls_domain (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 (R : BottomData) (row : R∈rows S a b d.c) {j : LiteralCall} (mem : j∈oneCalls T d u v R) :
 LiteralCallDomain T S a b d u v j := by

theorem literal_call_payload (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 {j : LiteralCall} (domain : LiteralCallDomain T S a b d u v j) :
 j.row.w.length+1≤(leaves S).length ∧ (leaves j.row.X).length≤(leaves S).length ∧ leaves j.row.X⊆leaves S ∧
 (leaves j.core).length≤(leaves T).length ∧ leaves j.core⊆leaves T ∧
 j.qa.length+1≤(leaves T).length ∧ j.ub.length+1≤(leaves T).length ∧
 LeafAt T j.qa j.row.a ∧ LeafAt T j.ub j.row.b := by
 have row:=row_payload S a b d.c domain.1

theorem literal_call_bits (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (d : BadSelection) (u v : RMAF.Vertex)
 {j : LiteralCall} (domain : LiteralCallDomain T S a b d u v j) (L : Nat)
 (tlabs : ∀x,x∈leaves T→x<2^L) (slabs : ∀x,x∈leaves S→x<2^L) :
 (∀x,x∈leaves j.row.X→x<2^L) ∧ (∀x,x∈leaves j.core→x<2^L) ∧
 j.row.a<2^L ∧ j.row.b<2^L := by
 have p:=literal_call_payload T S a b d u v domain
 have amem : j.row.a∈leaves T := by

theorem paid_selected_work (classFee : CheckRequest→Nat) (literalFee : LiteralCall→Nat)
 (T S : Tree) (a b L Kc Kl : Nat)
 (tlabs : ∀x,x∈leaves T→x<2^L) (slabs : ∀x,x∈leaves S→x<2^L)
 (classifier : ∀r,CheckDomain ((leaves T).length+(leaves S).length) L r→classFee r≤Kc)
 (literal : ∀d u v,(finalMeter classFee T S a b).value=some (.remaining d (.second u v))→
  ∀j,LiteralCallDomain T S a b d u v j→literalFee j≤Kl) :
 (paidSelectedMeter classFee literalFee T S a b).work≤paidSelectedBudget (leaves T).length (leaves S).length Kc Kl := by

theorem paid_selected_calls_domain (classFee : CheckRequest→Nat) (literalFee : LiteralCall→Nat)
 (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) {j : LiteralCall} (mem : j∈paidSelectedCalls classFee literalFee T S a b) :
 ∃d u v,(finalMeter classFee T S a b).value=some (.remaining d (.second u v)) ∧
 LiteralCallDomain T S a b d u v j ∧ u.length≤(leaves T).length ∧ v.length≤(leaves T).length ∧
 d.badArc.length+1≤(leaves S).length ∧ d.c∈leaves S := by
 unfold paidSelectedCalls at mem
 split at mem

theorem paid_selected_ledger (classFee : CheckRequest→Nat) (literalFee : LiteralCall→Nat)
 (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) :
 (paidSelectedMeter classFee literalFee T S a b).work≤(finalMeter classFee T S a b).work+
 secondBuilderBudget (leaves T).length (leaves S).length (leaves T).length 0+3+
 ((paidSelectedCalls classFee literalFee T S a b).map literalFee).sum := by
 simp only [paidSelectedMeter]
 split

def guardedPlan {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) : List Branch :=
 (literalPlan D).filter (currentGuard T S)

theorem literalPlan_guards {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) :
 ∀ child, child ∈ literalPlan D → currentGuard T S child = true :=
 literal_rawPlan_currentGuards D.properT D.properS D.same D.source D.cherry D.two
   D.core D.coreLabels D.bC D.cC D.leafA D.leafB D.leafC D.frontier D.tailR D.tailC D.offR D.offC

def currentGuard (T S : Tree) (c : Branch) : Bool :=
 decide c.originalCuts.Nodup &&
 c.originalCuts.all (fun q => !q.isEmpty && (subtree (current T S c) q).isSome) &&
 partitionCheck (leaves (current T S c)) c.partition &&
 pairwiseEmbeddings (current T S c) c.partition &&
 (c.partition.length == paid c + 1) &&
 (c.partition == arcPartition (current T S c) c.originalCuts)

@[macro_inline] instance {p q} [dp : Decidable p] [dq : Decidable q] : Decidable (And p q) where
  decide := and (decide p) (decide q)
  reflects_decide :=
    match dp, dq with
    | isTrue  hp, isTrue  hq => ⟨hp, hq⟩
    | isTrue   _, isFalse hq => fun h => hq h.2
    | isFalse hp, _          => fun h => hp (And.left h)

@[macro_inline] instance [dp : Decidable p] [dq : Decidable q] : Decidable (Or p q) where
  decide := or (decide p) (decide q)
  reflects_decide :=
    match dp, dq with
    | isTrue  hp, _          => .inl hp
    | isFalse  _, isTrue  hq => .inr hq
    | isFalse hp, isFalse hq => fun

protected def List.hasDecEq {α : Type u} [d : DecidableEq α] (a b : List α) : Decidable (Eq a b) where
  decide := a.beq b
  reflects_decide := go a b
where
  go : (a b : List α) → (a.beq b).Reflects (Eq a b)
  | nil, nil => rfl
  | cons _ _, nil => fun h => List.noConfusion rfl (heq_of_eq h)

instance {p q} [dp : Decidable p] [dq : Decidable q] : Decidable (p ↔ q) where
  decide := decide p == decide q
  reflects_decide :=
    match dp, dq with
    | isTrue  hp, isTrue  hq => ⟨fun _ => hq, fun _ => hp⟩
    | isTrue  hp, isFalse hq => fun h => hq (h.1 hp)
    | isFalse hp, isTrue  hq => fun h => hp (h.2 hq)

instance decidableBEx (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ l : List α, Decidable (Exists fun x => x ∈ l ∧ p x)
  | [] => isFalse nofun
  | x :: xs =>
    if h₁ : p x then isTrue ⟨x, .head .., h₁⟩ else
      match decidableBEx p xs with
      | isTrue h₂ => isTrue <| let ⟨y, hm, hp⟩ := h₂; ⟨y, .tail _ hm, hp⟩

instance decidableBAll (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ l : List α, Decidable (∀ x, x ∈ l → p x)
  | [] => isTrue nofun
  | x :: xs =>
    if h₁ : p x then
      match decidableBAll p xs with
      | isTrue h₂ => isTrue fun
